Container.description: Generic container wrapper. Use for grouping elements with padding, margin, and background color.

Row.description: Horizontal flex layout. Use for placing elements side by side.

Column.description: Vertical flex layout. Use for stacking elements top to bottom.

ScrollContainer.description: Scrollable container. Use for content that may overflow the screen.

SafeArea.description: Safe area container that respects device notches and system bars. Use as the outermost wrapper for screens.

Spacer.description: Empty space between elements. Set size for fixed spacing or flex for flexible spacing.

Pressable.description: Touchable wrapper that triggers events on press. Wrap any element to make it tappable. Bind on.press to setState to update state for visibility-driven UIs like tabs.

Divider.description: Thin line separator between content sections.

Heading.description: Heading text at various levels. h1 is largest, h4 is smallest.

Paragraph.description: Body text paragraph. Use for descriptions and longer content.

example.text: This is a paragraph of body text.

Label.description: Small utility text. Use for captions, form labels, and secondary information.

Image.description: Image display. Provide a source URL and optional dimensions.

Avatar.description: Circular avatar showing an image or initials. Use for user profiles and contacts.

Badge.description: Small colored indicator with a label. Use for status, counts, and categories.

Chip.description: Tag or filter chip. Bind on.remove for removable chips, on.press for selectable chips.

Button.description: Pressable button with label. Set variant for styling. Bind on.press for the handler to call on press.

TextInput.description: Text input field. Use $bindState to bind to the state model for two-way binding. The value typed by the user is stored at the bound path.

Switch.description: Toggle switch. Use $bindState to bind to the state model.

Checkbox.description: Checkbox for boolean selections. Use $bindState to bind to the state model.

Slider.description: Range slider for numeric values. Use $bindState to bind to the state model.

SearchBar.description: Search input with icon. Bind on.submit to trigger search on submit.

Spinner.description: Loading spinner indicator. Use while content is loading.

ProgressBar.description: Horizontal progress bar. Set progress from 0 to 1.

Card.description: Elevated card container with optional title. Use for grouping related content.

ListItem.description: List row with title, subtitle, and optional leading/trailing text. Bind on.press for the press handler.

Modal.description: Modal overlay dialog. Use $bindState on visible to bind visibility to the state model.

navigate.description: Navigate to a screen. Calls the user-provided navigation function.

goBack.description: Navigate back to the previous screen.

showAlert.description: Show a native alert dialog using Alert.alert().

share.description: Open the native share sheet using Share.share().

openURL.description: Open a URL in the default browser using Linking.openURL().

setState.description: Update a value in the state model at the given statePath.

pushState.description: Append an item to an array in the state model. The value can contain { $state: "/statePath" } references to read from current state, and "$id" to auto-generate a unique ID. Use clearStatePath to reset another path after pushing (e.g. clear an input field). Example: { statePath: "/todos", value: { id: "$id", title: { $state: "/newTodoText" }, completed: false }, clearStatePath: "/newTodoText" }.

removeState.description: Remove an item from an array in the state model at the given index.

refresh.description: Trigger a data refresh. Optionally specify a target to refresh.
